title: 617. Longest Line of Consecutive One in Matrix

examples.explanation: Three 1s line up along the main diagonal.
The entire top row is filled with 1s.

hints: Track four running lengths per cell: across, down, diagonal, and anti-diagonal.
Each direction extends the matching neighbor's count (upper, left, upper-left, upper-right).
A single dynamic-programming pass keeps the global maximum; zeros reset all four counts.
